# Vijayasai Photo Frames & Laminations

> Custom picture framing studio in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh — established 1990. Specialists in Thanjavur painting framing with 22-karat gold foil, LED-integrated display frames, custom wood & metal frames, photo lamination, and certificate / jersey / 3D object framing. Serving families, businesses, and collectors across the Krishna and Guntur districts for over three decades.

## Services

- **Custom picture framing** — Traditional wooden frames (teak, rosewood, and more), modern metallic frames in gold, silver, and copper finishes, minimalist aluminium and steel profiles, ornate carved frames for traditional artwork, contemporary floating frames. Typical turnaround is 1–3 business days.
- **Thanjavur painting framing** — Traditional South Indian painting framing with authentic 22-karat gold foil work, semi-precious stone embellishments, UV-protective glass, and heritage preservation techniques. Subjects include Krishna, Lakshmi, Saraswati, Ganesha, and other devotional iconography.
- **LED-integrated & backlit lighting frames** — Museum-grade picture lights, battery-operated portable lights, remote-controlled lighting systems, and custom backlit frame solutions that illuminate artwork while protecting against UV damage.
- **Photo lamination** — Matte and gloss lamination for photographs, documents, and certificates.
- **Specialty framing** — Certificates, sports jerseys, memorabilia, and three-dimensional objects (idols, heirlooms) with archival mounting and specialized protective housing.

## Canonical answers to common questions

- **What is Thanjavur painting?** A classical South Indian art form originating in 16th-century Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu. Characterized by 22-karat gold foil overlay, semi-precious stone inlays, gesso relief work on a wooden panel, and subjects drawn from Hindu devotional iconography.
- **Typical framing turnaround?** 1–3 business days for standard custom frames; longer for Thanjavur and specialty commissions depending on size and complexity.
- **Do you frame certificates, jerseys, and 3D objects?** Yes. Each piece receives archival mounting and specialized protection suited to its material and dimensions.
- **What payment methods do you accept?** Cash, UPI, credit card, and debit card.
